name: King
lines: On Land only, moves or captures one king step.
The King cannot move to Sky in Wyvern Chess.

name: Cleric
lines: On any level, moves or captures one king step.
On any level, may instead move or capture one level straight up or down.

name: Dragon
lines: On Sky only, moves or captures like a bishop or a king.
Instead of moving, may capture one enemy piece directly below it on Land, or next to that square.
When it captures from afar, the Dragon stays where it is.

name: Griffon
lines: On Sky, moves or captures like a zebra: two squares diagonally, then one square orthogonally, jumping over pieces.
On Sky, may instead move or capture diagonally down to Land, to a square next to the square below it.
On Land, moves or captures one diagonal step, or may move or capture diagonally up to Sky.

name: Oliphant
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a rook.

name: Thief
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a bishop.

name: Unicorn
lines: On Land only, moves or captures like a knight.

name: Warrior
lines: On Land only, moves one square straight forward without capturing.
Captures one square diagonally forward.
Promotes to an Oliphant when it reaches the far rank.

name: Wyvern
lines: On Sky only, moves one or two squares in any straight or diagonal direction. It jumps over pieces.
Instead of moving, may capture an enemy piece on Land directly below it. The Wyvern does not move when it does this.
Its value is a design estimate, not from Gygax.

name: Aarokocra
lines: On Sky only, moves or captures one square straight forward or diagonally forward. Never sideways or back.
Instead of moving, may capture up to two enemy pieces on Land: the square directly below, or one of the eight squares next to it.
A capture from afar does not move the Aarokocra. Its value is a design estimate.
